description: This image is a false-colour infrared aerial or satellite photograph depicting a landscape in Attali, Island of Evia, Greece. A prominent, dark blue, winding river flows through the scene. On either side of the river, extensive agricultural fields are visible in varying shades of bright red and light green/turquoise, indicating different vegetation types or stages of growth as seen in false-colour infrared. Along the bends of the river, two distinct areas of very dark red to purplish vegetation are highlighted by yellow arrows. These areas represent "Other natural coniferous (spruce) forest", serving as an example for land cover classification within nomenclature guidelines. On the right side of the image, a settlement is visible, characterized by a network of light-coloured roads and buildings interspersed with red-toned vegetation patches. The image illustrates the spatial distribution of riverine, coniferous forest, agricultural, and urban land cover/land use (LCLU) types.
